## Advance Deal

Moves an Opportunity/Deal's `stage` field forward, guarded by `canTransition` from `pipeline-stage-field.gts`. Re-fetches the subject via `GetCardCommand` before reading its stage, per this realm's established convention (a caller may pass a card whose fields were never loaded).

### Non-goals
Does not decide business rules beyond the stage graph itself (e.g. required fields per stage) — that belongs to a consumer app's own workflow, not this command.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at the real, already-existing `Deal/acme-enterprise-renewal` instance (currently in `negotiation`, one legal move away from `closed won`/`closed lost`).
